extracted.intended_audience: creative marketing and communications professionals, brands, agencies, creators, and prospective Cannes Lions attendees
extracted.subtask_description: A promotional/informational page for the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity 2026 aimed at encouraging attendance, showcasing programmes and awards, and describing what kinds of creative work and topics the Festival highlights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Celebration of creativity, effectiveness and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating creativity, effectiveness and innovation in the global advertising, marketing and communication industries – it's where creatives and marketers from around the world come together to celebrate history in the making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Festival and Awards centre on work that demonstrates creativity, measurable effectiveness and innovative approaches; awarded work sets the benchmark for global creative excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award benchmark: global creative excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: The Awards are where the new benchmark for global creative excellence is set each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants/awarded work are presented as examples that define the year's highest standards; attendees are invited to 'watch the work awarded on stage, or make history yourself.' This implies awards value work that advances or redefines excellence across creativity, impact and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative Brand Lion criteria: systems, cultures and capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The new Creative Brand Lion recognises the systems, cultures and capabilities that make world-class creative inevitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award emphasizes organizational/operational qualities (not just individual executions): effective internal systems, cultures that foster creativity, and capabilities that consistently produce world-class creative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: LIONS Sport focus: business of sport marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: LIONS Sport — a new two-day programme dedicated to the business of competition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming and awarded/featured work in this stream will be judged on relevance and value to the sport marketing/business of competition sector — practical business outcomes, sector-specific creativity and commercial relevance are implied priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: LIONS Creators focus: creator economy relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: LIONS Creators — the pass, programme and place for the creator economy, with access to an exclusive beach space, stage, content studio, editing suite and activations around the business of influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work and sessions here prioritise creator-economy formats and practices (influence, content creation, platform-native creativity); suitability for creators and influencer-driven business models is a key criterion for inclusion.
